name: SaaSBison

sources.title: SaaSBison submit page — Free vs Premium listing plans

conditions: Free listing requires displaying the SaaSBison badge on your site
Free listings sit in a 'slow manual review queue' with no stated SLA
requirements: Software/SaaS product with a live website
Curated directory: no crypto, adult, gambling or illegal content (removed with full refund if paid)
Free tier listing copy is limited to roughly 1,500 characters
preparation: Product name, URL and ~1,500-char description (free tier)
A page on your site where the SaaSBison badge can be embedded
Decide Free vs Premium ($9.99 one-time, advertised down from $29.99) before starting the 3-step form
workflow: Embed the SaaSBison badge on your site
Wait for manual review; listing goes live after approval
watchFor: Premium ($9.99 one-time) buys instant approval, 3 dofollow backlinks, an AI-written ~3,500-char listing and removes the badge requirement
Checkout cross-sells a $149 '60+ directories' done-for-you service via partner LaunchDirectories
Badge must stay on the site for the free listing to remain valid
Paid checkout handled by Polar as merchant of record
countsAsLive: A public product detail page at saasbison.com/item/<slug> that also appears under its chosen category.
unknowns: Exact free-tier review time ('slow manual review queue' is not quantified)
Specific form fields inside the 3-step submit flow (JS-rendered)
Whether an account is required before submitting
